Store the marks of several students in a nested dictionary.

Supplied answer
students = {}
for _ in range(2):
    name = input("Enter name: ")
    phy = int(input("Physics marks: "))
    maths = int(input("Maths marks: "))
    students[name] = {"phy": phy, "maths": maths}
print(students)
for name, marks in students.items():
    print(name, "total =", marks["phy"] + marks["maths"])
Note: A dictionary value can itself be a dictionary - this is called nesting.
